messages:
maria: Dropping updated toolbar mock for batch embeddings + rerank. Main ask: does the ordering feel intuitive and accessible? figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example2

sam: skimmed. toolbar order feels fine but the spacing makes the primary action blend with secondary. suggestion: primary on left, space, then compact group for sampling/export on right.

lina: a11y note: the sample size slider needs a visible focus ring and an accessible label (e.g., "Preview sample size"). keyboard users should be able to increment with arrow keys.

kevin: UX nit: when sample is set to 100% we should hide the "Preview" badge and show full-set indicator to avoid implying randomness. also add a small tooltip: "Using entire dataset may take longer".

ada: Copy tweak: replace "Export" with "Download (.csv)" and move it to the far right. Also change the preview CTA from "Run" to "Preview results" so it's clear it's not committing changes.

maria: sounds good. Lina, can you propose the exact aria attributes? We need: aria-label on slider, aria-live polite on result count, and role=status for the small status line.

lina: yes. suggested attributes: slider: role=slider, aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow and aria-label="Preview sample size". results region: role=status and aria-live=polite with text like "Preview complete: 12 results".

sam: some micro-interaction thought: when users toggle "include original text" in export, persist that choice in local UI state for the session. saves a click.

kevin: performance thing: when previewing with sampling on, avoid clearing the results table until new preview rows are ready. show a subtle loading shimmer over the new rows rather than blanking. this keeps context.

ada: tiny CSV header suggestion (we'll let eng confirm schema):

```
source_id,embedding_dim,vector,original_text
```

and include a short help tooltip next to Download that explains vector truncation for very long text.

maria: action list from this thread:
- move Download (.csv) to far right and rename (ada)
- set primary Preview label to "Preview results" (ada + sam)
- implement aria roles/labels Lina suggested (lina)
- keep prior results visible until new preview ready; add row shimmer (kevin)
- persist export toggles in session storage (sam)
- update figma frames and drop back here when done (maria)

lina: I'll run a quick keyboard walkthrough and post notes (focus order, skip links, aria).

kevin: I'll mock the shimmer timing and a small CSS spec for focus rings.

ada: will update copy and tooltips in figma now.

maria: thanks all. target for next pass: Tue morning. tagging @design-bot for an accessibility scan once frames updated.
